Game Overview

Hole Digger in Russia puts players into a simulation experience centered on embark on a quirky adventure to find Grandpa's lost car keys in the depths of a Russian yard. Dig deeper to discover hidden treasures, upgrade your tools, and enhance your skills. Unearth secrets beneath the soil, but remember your mission—turn Grandpa back into a legend!
